grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, butter, cheddar, eggs, milk, carrots and thyme are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday supermarket item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: A bowl, grater, whisk and baking tray are ordinary kit, and rubbing in is beginner technique.

works.reason: 350g flour to 75g butter, with an egg, about 150ml milk and moist grated carrot, gives a sound soft dough that makes 8 good wedges for four at a hot oven temperature.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers grating two carrots and the cheese, picking thyme and rubbing in, and the 18-minute bake matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and the egg wash and dusting flour come from listed items.

seasonal_feel.reason: October carrots lead the title and the dough, and warm cheese scones suit an autumn afternoon.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British kitchen instructions a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: A cheese and carrot scone with egg and milk is a filling snack of real food that families would make again.
